definitions.explanation: The quality of being usable in many different situations or for many purposes. Commonly used when evaluating tools, skills, technology, or methods.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{道具|どうぐ}→道具：01479_dougu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{汎用性|はんようせい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧。
{汎用性|はんようせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{技術|ぎじゅつ}→技術：01389_gijutsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{身|み}→身：01764_mi⟧につけたい。
examples.english: I want to acquire versatile skills.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦ソフトウェア→ソフトウェア：04719_sofutowea⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{汎用性|はんようせい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{優|すぐ}れて→優れる：02119_sugureru⟧おり、さまざまな⟦{業種|ぎょうしゅ}→業種：13149_gyoushu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{使|つか}われている→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: This software excels in versatility and is used across various industries.

notes:
{汎用性|はんようせい} describes how widely applicable something is — whether a tool, skill, technology, or method can be used in many different situations.

FORMS:
⟦{汎用|はんよう}→汎用：07653_hanyou⟧ (general-purpose) + ⟦{性|せい}→性：09880_sei⟧ (quality, -ness). The base word ⟦{汎用|はんよう}→汎用：07653_hanyou⟧ means "general-purpose" and appears in compounds like ⟦{汎用|はんよう}→汎用：07653_hanyou⟧⟦{機|き}→〜機：09843_ki⟧ (general-purpose machine).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {汎用性|はんようせい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧: highly versatile
- {汎用性|はんようせい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{低|ひく}い→低い：02947_hikui⟧: not very versatile
- {汎用性|はんようせい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{優|すぐ}れる→優れる：02119_sugureru⟧: to excel in versatility
- {汎用性|はんようせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧〜: versatile ~

REGISTER:
Commonly used in technical, business, and product evaluation contexts. Somewhat formal — in casual speech, ⟦{使|つか}い{道|みち}→使い道：07798_tsukaimichi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧ (has many uses) conveys a similar idea.
